# Zerdinals and ZRunes

> Public documentation for the Zcash digital-artifact product at
> https://zrunes.io: Zerdinals inscriptions, ZRunes, ZRC-20 tokens,
> collections, and the ZordiScan explorer. Every availability claim defers
> to the status page; every figure in the product is read from
> first-party Zcash infrastructure.

The authoritative Markdown source for every page listed below lives at
https://github.com/bitcoinuniverseio/docs-zerdinals-and-zrunes under
src/content/docs/.

## Start here

- [What this is](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-zerdinals-and-zrunes/start/what-this-is/)
- [Safety in sixty seconds](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-zerdinals-and-zrunes/start/safety/)
- [Current status](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-zerdinals-and-zrunes/start/status/)
